---

# NARRATIVE REFUTATION

## Era 1 (v1 → founding)

**SURVIVES — and this is the most accurate era in the account.** I tried to break four claims and failed all four.

- `b506b572` body + `~/ActiveCellSim/docs/v1/production_lam4_finding.md` REVISION 1/2: the historian's reading is exact — "A/A₀_topdown(end) = 2.643" in the commit, retracted in-doc as a `contact_xy_hull/A₀` mislabel, true top-down peak **1.570 @ 7.75 h → end 1.409**, reclassified P2 → **P3 strict**. The retraction predates any pivot justified on it. Corroborated.
- `6f23aa4b`: Magic-Number Block + Gate-Semantics-Immutability + the 5-check Sanity-Gate Protocol are all in the same commit as "Magic-number anti-pattern (csf_kappa_scale 0.25 → 0.05, Ca 0.01 → 0.001) found and fully reverted". Verbatim.
- `80f8fb8`: `git log -1 --format='%b'` returns literally empty; `git show --numstat` confirms the same commit adds `docs/v4/v4_round21_wardetzky_bending_derivation.md` **+469/-0**; `grep -ril wardetzky aleph/` returns nothing. The era's cleanest catch, fully verified.
- `9d40c09`: "8 brief-listed KU ✅ VALIDATIONs", "56/56 pass in 8.4 s", "Deviations #2 KU-5.5 ξ_v widened to [1, 400] μm". Verbatim.
- `3f94ddcd`: `476 files changed, 574 insertions(+), 110060 deletions(-)`. Exact.
- `git show 3f94ddcd:CLAUDE.md`: exactly **4** hard rules under "carried over from v1"; the table's 6th row is "Integrator | Euler-Maruyama | L-M BAOAB"; ×40 is "the **only** sanctioned coarse-graining"; runtime is HOOMD; "Hardware through Phase 1: Apple silicon CPU". **Era 1's lessons #11 and #12 — that "Time integration" and "Compartment coupling" are NOT Era-1 rows — are correct and are the account's best self-policing.** Era 1 also correctly refuses to credit v1 for the six-axis structural proof (which is Layer-2's, a month later, on a different abstraction).

**MISSING from Era 1:** nothing material. It is the only era that pre-emptively downgrades its own strongest rhetorical asset.

---

## Era 2 (ff/)

**SURVIVES on its central claim.** Its anti-post-hoc argument is the strongest single result in the whole account: `FF_ENGINE_STATE_AUDIT_2026-07-07.md` really does contain, in Korean with file:line, "핵 bead는 오직 핵 인덱스에만 힘을 씀 … MT와 동일한 inert passenger" and "merged K가 {cortex+nucleus} vs {MT+MTOC}로 **block-diagonal**". The structural indictment genuinely predates the 07-16 pivot by nine days, from an independent audit. I could not refute this.

**DOWNGRADED — three items.**

1. **The pivot day is tidier than the day.** Both Era 2 and the ledger render 07-16 as a clean three-beat. `git log --date=format:'%m-%d %H:%M'` shows the ladder kept **passing and growing** after 02:44 (`bfbd531c` 23/23 @02:47, `d0f92ad1` 25/25 @02:53, `de6a105f` 26/26 @02:56, `3973a550` 27/27 @09:20, `8ca19575` 28/28 @09:22); `340e80be` (10:51) emerged out of `063fc4ea` (10:20, wiring spatial Biot FSI); and the immediate response was **four hours of in-place remediation** — `765655ae` 11:03 "unfreezes MT", `5b7e2c90` 11:55 "couple Biot to EVERY compartment", `e1433296` 12:31, `fef3c787` 12:55 "+ honest first-landing finding", `ce77b645` 12:59 "honest: nucleus not yet flattened". The condemnation lands only at 14:25/15:39. The real sequence is diagnostic → four remediation attempts → the remediations' own honest findings → pivot. Pivot still forced; narrative compressed.
2. **"The parity guarantee is the one headline that still stands unqualified"** — the project's own `outputs/tag_kb/run_audit_report.md` marks **9 rows GPU_UNREPRODUCED** ("present but GPU-only, no committed build/CI trace"), including `warp-gpu-B1-baoab-kt0`, `warp-gpu-mshake`, and the H.7 speedups. Qualified, not unqualified.
3. **A corroborated claim creates an uninvestigated problem.** If the composition was indicted on 07-07 with code citations, then the 07-14/15 S1–S3 hierarchical campaign (Era 2's "last substantive FF-owned science") and the entire 22-part ladder were run on a composition already known to be broken. Era 2 uses the 07-07 audit **purely exculpatorily**. The same artifact indicts the nine days that followed it, and no historian asks why they happened.

---

## Era 3 (dcm/)

**SURVIVES — the best-corroborated era after Era 1.**

- `DCM_SPREADING_LIMIT_CONCLUSION_2026-07-01.md` §Empirical: the 1.000 / 1.000 / 1.000 / **1.003** table, "bundle 167 = **5.01 nN/FA** (167×)", "3422 bonds ruptured", "basal footprint 139→138 nodes". Verbatim.
- `aleph/dcm`: **zero** commits since 2026-07-14 (`git log --since=2026-07-15 -- aleph/dcm` → 0).
- `SUCCESSOR_HANDOFF_TO_OPUS5_2026-07-25.md`: `grep -ci "dcm\|spheroid\|multicell"` → **0**. Exact.
- `run_audit_report.md` today: C14 **RETRACT**, C12/C13/C17 **NEEDS_REGEN**, warp parity rows VERIFIED. The "infrastructure stands, science headlines don't" split is live, not historical.

**MISSING from Era 3 — a whole representation generation (attack #3).** The **Layer-2 center-based CBM line** gets no pivot entry anywhere. `git log` shows it running 2026-06-02 → 06-05 (`114aea57` → `942dc8a0`, ~50 commits), 25 MB of committed outputs, its own `REPORT.md` and a paper-ready `Layer2_Report.docx`. It is a deliberately **one-particle-per-cell** spheroid — maximally lumped — opened *inside* ffn_cellsim on the shared HOOMD/BAOAB stack **two weeks after** the founding principle "처음 프레임워크에 추상화나 다른 과정이 들어가면 안됨". Era 1 mentions it only as a framing caution about the structural-limit proof; Era 3 mentions only its closure as dcm/'s precondition. Nobody records the decision to **open** it, nobody flags the tension with the founding principle, nobody counts it as a generation. The combined account therefore reads as monotonically increasing fidelity when the project in fact reopened a point-cell abstraction in June and closed it in four days.

---

## Era 4 (ac/)

**SURVIVES on three items, one DOWNGRADED to wrong.**

Corroborated: the 0.21 pN gate has **no derivation anywhere** — first appearance is `RESTING_BASELINE_DIAGNOSIS_2026-07-22c.md:79` as a bare "gate ≈ 0.21", thereafter only as a literal (`ac_resting_converge.py:1,40,57`). Era 4's category-(d) finding stands. `AC_ENGINE_INTEGRATION_PLAN_2026-07-22.md:170` really says "173 tests all mock the device; the single real force-kernel test is CUDA-skipped and has never executed", and §6 really is corrected in place with the words "citing them as closure was a **gate substitution**". Era 4's composed-native discrepancy is verified and **stronger than it claimed**: the handoff supplies specific numbers ("NMII 3465/8840 heads 이벤트 결합, accepted-step clock 0→1") that appear in no committed artifact, `495ac651`'s own body says "the CUDA composed STEP … **NOT yet native-run, mechanism demo**", and no `outputs/ac/composed*` artifact exists.

**DOWNGRADED — P4.4 is a sanitised failure (attack #4).** Era 4 presents "FD probe REFUTES the 22c root cause; operator exact to 1.0000; the blocker is **conditioning**" as a durable measured pivot whose cost was retiring the tangent-assembly direction. Both halves were refuted by the project within two days and Era 4 reports neither:

- `d75e6631` (07-24): "The 2026-07-22d `s_op = s_fd` result was **STALE** (pre-directional-force)" — and it fixes a **real tangent bug**: 4 crossbridge kernels used isotropic `kI` where the exact tangent is rank-one `K = k·wwᵀ`, injecting spurious ⊥ stiffness. The "retired" direction was partly right.
- `0489baea` (07-24): "k_xb-sensitivity — **REFUTES conditioning**" — residual identical to 6 sig-figs across 10× stiffness.

The ledger lists both in a dead-end chain; Era 4's pivot statement is simply wrong as of 2026-07-24.

---

## Cross-era ledger

### REFUTED: PV-01's evidence rests on a retracted number (attack #1)

PV-01's `forcing_reason` and `evidence` cite `b506b572`'s **2.643** and specifically that "the commit explicitly excluded … mechanism-missing-strict (Bucket P3 <2.5)". The project's own Rule-11 audit retracted that number and reclassified the run **TO Bucket P3**. The ledger's evidence sentence asserts the opposite of the corrected record, and does so while Era 1 — reading the same two sources — gets it right. The pivot survives; PV-01's anchoring does not. Use Era 1's version.

### REFUTED: the "HOOMD cupy port ≈ 2-week DCM dead end" is post-hoc rationalisation plus invented causality (attacks #1 and #2)

This is the ledger's worst item. Checked against the same-period record:

- The cupy/RawKernel work is **H.7 HOOMD cortex, not DCM**, and it is dated **06-07 → 06-09**, roughly three days: `7e61ebe0`, `815ac222` ("native-vs-cupy constrained integrator"), `d3dd1fd7` ("parity 1.5e-15"), `08aa269a` ("parity 1e-15"), `4d06e53a` ("fused BAOAB raw-kernel"), `55799425` ("GPU parity VALIDATED on gbook (rel 2.25e-16)").
- It **did not fail**. `memory/project-native-constrained-integrator.md`: "DONE+validated", "integrator-only **44.06×**", "full-cell end-to-end 6.32×", "γ statistical parity PASS", and the cupy path was the *reference implementation* the native plugin was validated against.
- DCM never had a cupy port; its GPU work went straight to Warp (`1f6389fa`, 06-20).
- The "~2 weeks" and the word "waste" exist **only** in `memory/feedback-never-mention-hoomd-cuda-port.md`, dated **2026-06-20** — after the Warp decision. A PI retrospective, uncorroborated by any same-period artifact, presented by the ledger as a measured cost.
- **The invented causality is explicit:** "The commit gap 2026-06-15 → 2026-06-19 sits exactly where it should." That window is bracketed by DCM two-stage spreading work (`fc876b3c`, 06-15) and by CI + the results-integrity/retraction pass (`a664f27d`, `69f0d91a`, `19c9fc34`, 06-19). No cupy work is anywhere near it. This is precisely the standard the project sets for itself ("공간상관≠인과") applied to space but not to time.

Downgrade to: **PI-judgement pivot with a retrospective justification the contemporaneous artifacts do not support.**

### GATE A: both historians stopped one step short (attack #4)

`GATE_A_RESTING_CONVERGENCE_2026-07-23.md` §10 ends: "**Decision (Lead, 2026-07-24 — SURFACED to PI for ratification).**" I can find **no PI ratification** — no commit, no doc, and GATE A does not appear in the 2026-07-25 PI-decision queue (`SUCCESSOR_HANDOFF … §2`, which lists four other pending items). Yet `30383867` the same day and `ROLLING_ROADMAP.md:5-7` (SoT, refreshed 07-25) state "**✅ GATE A CLOSED**" as settled fact. A lead-authored change to *what the gate measures* and *on what configuration* went from "surfaced for ratification" to SoT fact within hours, then fell off the sign-off queue. Two further unreported details sharpen it: the metric change was triggered by an external "**Consultation (PI-relayed)**" (`d75e6631`), not internal diagnosis; and the project's own words are "**~80 % of the prior 5.79 'blocker' was mismeasurement + stale tangent**". The ledger's instinct (least willing to take the project's word here) is right; both historians understate the finding.

### PV-09's mechanism is wrong in a way that makes the failure worse

The ledger says the 22/22 ladder "tested pieces and never the composition". `FF_ENGINE_REVALIDATION_LADDER_2026-07-16.md:17-20` says the opposite: "A compartment is TRUSTED only when all its parts PASS **and their composition PASSES**. The cell is TRUSTED only when all compartments PASS **and the pre-stressed assembly PASSES**." The ladder demanded composition validation, declared P6.1 a "trustworthy baseline", and the composition was proven broken eight hours later. This is a gate that was **not enforced**, not a gate with the wrong scope.

### The H.2 rebanding is worse than reported — in the account's favour

`444ef010`: `angle_ks_p_min: 1.0e-6 # widened from 0.05`; `equipartition_rel_tol_3d: 0.60 # ±60% covers … H.2 +50%`; and then "**Existing H.2 production trajectory … verified to PASS all 3 rebanded gates without re-running.**" The bands were set against the failing data already in hand. The ledger called this the rule's sanctioned channel "operating at the limit"; the commit shows it operating past the limit. Understated, not overstated.

### Unverifiable as stated

"9 of 37 committed `REPORT.md` files carry retraction banners (24%)." I count 37 `REPORT.md` and **15** matching `retract|superseded|withdrawn|correction`. The 9 may reflect a stricter banner definition, but the figure is not reproducible from disk as written. Right in spirit, uncheckable as a number.

---

## MISSING PIVOTS (attack #3) and SURVIVORSHIP BIAS (attack #5)

**A. The Phase-1 H-unit program died with no recorded verdict — and CLAUDE.md is still stale on it.** H.1/H.2/H.3/H.4/H.5 all have committed `outputs/h*/REPORT.md` closeouts. **H.7, H.8 and H.9 have none.** H.7 — the flagship full-cell γ unit — last received work on 2026-06-11 (`c35faebc`, "SF traction seed-instability cross-check — BOOT HALT CORROBORATED"); after that `outputs/h7/` is touched only by DCM commits (`69f0d91a`, `60839269`, `8088c624`). No commit, doc or audit records ending the H-chain; it was overtaken. Meanwhile the CLAUDE.md that the whole account treats as the durable product still states, on 2026-07-25, "Phase 1 runs as a **single Lead Claude Code session driving the whole H.1 → H.2 → H.3 → H.5 → H.7 chain**" and still lists the Phase-1 briefs as the active roadmap. A category-(d) pivot **inside the governance document the account credits**. No historian mentions it.

**B. The sharpest survivorship bias: the results-integrity gate has never covered ff/ or ac/.** `outputs/tag_kb/results_manifest.yaml` holds exactly **31** claims, and every path in it is `outputs/h_dcm_two_stage` or `outputs/h7` — DCM/warp-port era only. Its last substantive commit is `d8ab9c71`/`13435b62` (2026-06-21); `4a143b99` (06-29) is a `warp_port→dcm` path rename. **ff/ was born 2026-06-29. ac/ on 2026-07-16.** So `make kb-check` — a MANDATORY session-closeout step, credited by both Era 3 and the ledger as the permanent instrument DCM's failures produced — has been **green by vacuity for the entire ff/ and ac/ eras**. It audits nothing that produced the γ-floor, the AFM retraction stack, GATE A, GATE B, or the composed cell. The one claim Era 4 flags as uncorroborated (composed native "gbook gate PASS", contradicted by its own commit body) is exactly the class this gate exists to catch, and the gate cannot see it. Both historians present the gate as a lesson that took; it is a lesson that took **and then stopped travelling**.

**C. Publishing outward is an uncosted decision.** ~10+ `site(gh-pages)` commits 2026-07-06 → 07-14 build a public gallery and landing page; the repo went public 07-06 — the same day `463f3222` had to strip a retracted footprint-spreading claim, a coarse-proxy necrosis movie, and "the r2=0.998 spreading-law headline (not re-derivable from committed disk)". The ledger uses `463f3222` only as a latency data point. Nobody treats "begin external publication while four headline DCM results sit at RETRACT/NEEDS_REGEN" as a direction change with a cost.

**Deletions and gaps: the account is adequate here, and I say so.** Across all 1930 commits only two exceed 4,000 deletions — `3f94ddcd` (110,060, accounted for) and `081ce344` (7,760, a gh-pages viewer restyle). `be7ce5a7` is the archival of the founding `cortex/bridge/junction/integrator/ecm/cell` packages, correctly covered by Era 2. Commit gaps >2 days: 05-06→05-18 (12 d, covered), 05-21→05-25, 06-15→06-19, 06-26→06-29, 07-03→07-06. No hidden mass abandonment. Attack #3 found no *concealed* deletion — only the three unrecorded direction changes above.

---

## OVERALL VERDICT

**The trajectory as told is honest in structure and unusually well-anchored in detail — but it is tidier than the evidence in four specific, correctable ways, and it flatters the project's rule set.**

What is genuinely established: four of the five era-boundary pivots are forced, in the categories claimed, by evidence that predates or is contemporaneous with the decision. E1-P1 (measured ceiling, with the project's own retraction of its best-looking number *before* the pivot), E1-P2 (structural: unmeasurable coefficients), E3-P5 (structural: five mechanisms, 167×, all 1.000), E3-P7 (structural, by the direction of the error under refinement — the strongest single argument in the history), and P2.7/PV-09 (structural, indicted independently nine days early) all survive adversarial reading. Two pivots are correctly labelled unrecoverable (`80f8fb8`; the 0.21 gate) and the account treats those as findings rather than gaps, which is the right posture.

The failures cluster in one place: **wherever the account relies on a later retrospective instead of a same-period artifact, it inherits that retrospective's rationalisation.** The cupy-port dead end (PI memory dated after the pivot, wrong engine, wrong duration, gap-as-cause), PV-01's evidence (a number the project itself had retracted), and Era 4's P4.4 (a refutation the project later declared stale) are all the same error. The brief warned that the agents who made the decisions also wrote the justifications; the account applies that scepticism ruthlessly to Era 1 and barely at all to Eras 2–4, which are closer in time and written by the same lineage.

And the account's closing thesis — that the durable product is the rule set — is half-earned. The ledger's own summary line ("the rules function as detection scaffolding, not prevention — every one of them has been violated at least once *after* being written") is the most honest sentence in the five submissions and it survives every check I made. But the account credits three instruments it does not verify are still live: the results-integrity gate covers only the era that created it, the Phase-1 governance model in CLAUDE.md is dead text, and one gate closure (GATE A) is recorded in the SoT as ratified when the record shows it was only surfaced. On this project's own standard — disk overrides the claim, and a grep is not verification — those three are exactly the kind of thing that should have been checked before being credited.

AN HONEST ANSWER ABOUT THE WORK **Diagnosis quality: high, and rising.** The best diagnostic in the project is the BDF2 test, because it draws a structural conclusion from the *direction* of an error under refinement rather than from a value — a more accurate integrator freezing *more* proves the gap is event-limited and closes the whole integrator axis at once. Close behind: `ff/`'s γ ablation (flat across connectivity including sub-isostatic, flat across EA over three decades, no Ronceray amplification ⇒ force magnitude, not network mechanism) and the 07-25 fine-mesh chain, where three successive measurements refuted two of the session's *own* hypotheses and located an 8 nm construction artifact. Speed is genuinely good: v1's ceiling was diagnosed within ~24 h of the production run *and the good-looking number was retracted before any pivot rested on it*; the AFM overshoot went 857× → 16.5× → ~17 Pa in roughly 36 hours across four measured steps. The counterweight is that diagnoses get **committed before they are tested** — five root causes for one gate in 48 hours — which is only cheap because the refutation cadence is fast. **Self-catching: unusually high, with one structural blind spot.** The distinction survives every check I made: errors inside a hypothesis under active test are caught in hours and cost nothing (peeling artifact within 4 commits; the tuned pancake claim same-session; steric refuted within a day). Errors in configuration and measurement that nobody is currently looking at are caught in weeks and almost always by the PI (basal A/A₀: 7 days to banners, 24 more to leave the public README; SettlingForce; the cad-bundle sweep; `density_per_fil`; Π₀). That is not a character flaw — it is a missing instrument, and the missing instrument is precisely the one the project believes it already has. **Did pivots preserve value?** Mostly yes. HOOMD→Warp preserved everything via per-force-law parity; `ff/`→`ac/` preserved every kernel (an `ff/` commit on 07-25 is still `ac/` work); `dcm/` was parked in place, not deleted; superseded machinery is flagged default-off with explicit do-not-re-queue notes. One clear destruction: the v1→v2 cut, where 110,060 lines went and the same physics class had to be re-derived at least twice — v4's triangulated-cell-on-fiber-ECM reappearing as `dcm/` with no document linking them, and the 06-04 spanning-mesh cortex fix re-derived from scratch on 07-23 after being found unwired. **Were the rules encoded?** **Partly, and along a sharp line.** Rules expressible as a static check are encoded and hold: oracles-never-imported (verified clean in `ac/` three generations later), HOOMD-never-executed (contract test + scoped `testpaths`), one-filament-one-owner (asserted at build *and every accepted step*). Rules requiring judgement are written, have each been violated after being written — several times — and are today guarded only by a sentence a future session must remember. Three instruments the project believes it has do not currently function: `kb-check`'s results gate covers 31 claims, none from `ff/` or `ac/`; its params gate covers 42 constants, all in Phase-1 oracle YAMLs; and `forces_manifest` exists only in a June document. And `CLAUDE.md` still presents the H.1→H.7 chain as the active program while h7/h8/h9 have no closeout and the chain has had no work since 06-11. The ledger's own line — *"the rules function as detection scaffolding, not prevention"* — is the most honest sentence in the whole account and it survives every check. **The single best decision: the oracle inversion** — `CODEBASE_AUDIT.md:116-123` + `PHASE_0_3_DECISIONS.md:1-15` (2026-05-19), "v1 = paper-models-as-mechanism, v2 = paper-models-as-validation-oracle." It is the only decision that survived four engine generations unchanged; the only hard rule with a clean violation record; verifiably still enforced today; and it is what made every later refutation *possible*, because a closed form you compare against is worth more than one you compute with. It was also made **against the evidence of the moment** — acs_kb had just passed 8/8 KU and 56/56 tests that same day — which is the rarest kind of good decision: killing something that works because it can only ever work inside its own regime. **The single most costly decision: permitting lumped/body-force proxies as default-on development stand-ins without a force-state manifest** — crystallised on 2026-06-21 in the SettlingForce landmine register (`05bb9799`, `da5cff73`; recurrence at `CYTOSKELETON_CYTOSOL_REAUDIT_2026-07-16.md:55-58`; public consequence at `463f3222`). Its cost chain is the longest in the project: a proxy at 19,000–47,000× real buoyant weight, ON in every committed spread run and mislabelled `proxy_off`, doing the flattening credited to the lamellipodium, with the project's own regression gates locking the confound in so a *correct* fix would have registered as a regression — invalidating every pre-06-21 DCM spread run **including the capstone A/A₀ law**, which then went public on 07-06 and had to be stripped from the README. Found only by PI pushback. The same class recurred four weeks later in a different engine, and the instrument designed to stop it was never built. *Runner-up, and the largest pure time loss: the 05-02→05-06 lock/review treadmill — 205 commits, 84 of them docs, ~37 review-id fixes many of them documentation nits, zero physics, abandoned with an empty commit body.* **And the fair summary.** Measured against ordinary computational-biology practice this record is well above average, and the harshness above should not be read otherwise: the project retracts its own headlines in place with the corrected sign stated, generates most of its refutations itself, has twice killed working code on principle, and now publishes what it *cannot* claim (32 PI-GAP slots, 8 of 9 components "magnitude INVALID") instead of retracting it later — which is the correct direction of travel and rare anywhere. The failure mode is neither dishonesty nor sloppiness. It is that **the guards are ~80% cultural, and the rate at which the project creates new surface area exceeds the rate at which it sources and gates that surface.** Both halves of that sentence are fixable with the six conversions in §5, and none of them is a research problem.
